item.title: Mickey Rourke Condemns GoFundMe Campaign as Fundraiser Goes Offline
item.description: Mickey Rourke has issued a further public statement condemning a GoFundMe campaign created in his name, with the fundraiser no longer visible on the platform. The actor confirmed that over $100,000 had been raised and said his legal team is working to ensure donors receive their money back. item.title: Clear Frontrunner Emerges for Manny Pacquiao’s Next Fight
item.description: A clear frontrunner has emerged for Manny Pacquiao’s next fight after developments over the past two weeks effectively narrowed what had been a three-name discussion to one realistic option. item.title: Ali Act Amendments Advance as Congress Details Changes to Boxing Regulation
